result.planSummary: Revised Story 2 rendering so full-band at-or-behind-boundary tool results always use deterministic raw-result truncation and tail tool calls render recorded arguments as-is, including long arguments.

changedFiles.reason: Removed provider-summary use from boundary tool-result rendering and removed deterministic truncation from tail tool-call argument rendering.
Added focused Story 2 coverage for long tail tool-call arguments rendered as recorded with no truncation or tool_call_summary.
Updated boundary expectations to prove deterministic tool-result floors are rendered even when ready tool_result_summary content exists.
Updated stale mid-tail boundary expectation to reject provider-summary content on the boundary-rendered tool-result surface.
Updated healed sweep view expectation so ready summary derivations affect sweep accounting but not boundary tool-result rendering.
